data.name: Thane
data.long_meaning: In Old English, Thane translates to 'person' or 'settler'. Historically, it was a term for a man who was not a nobleman but held a position of power or influence within a community. The name has been used in English literature and mythology, such as the character Thane of Cawdor in Macbeth.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of dedication and commitment to one's community.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, creative, and socially gifted individuals. Threes have a natural ability to inspire and motivate others.

in_hebrew.name: תיין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: המילה תיין מקורה כנראה מהמילה העברית 'תין' שפירושה אציל, נדיב, או שר. בתקופה המקראית, תואר זה ניתן לאנשים ממעמד גבוה או לאנשים בעלי השפעה רבה. המונח קשור גם למושגים של כוח, מנהיגות ומעמד חברתי גבוה.

in_greek.name: Θάνης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Θάνης πιθανόν σχετίζεται με την ελληνική λέξη 'τίνος' που σημαίνει υπηρέτης ή ακόλουθος. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιοι τίτλοι χρησιμοποιούνται για να περιγράψουν υπηρετες ή ακόλουθους του Χριστού. Ο όρος συνδέεται επίσης με έννοιες υπηρέτησης, σεβασμού και αφοσίωσης.

in_latin.name: Thane
in_latin.long_meaning: Terminus 'Thane' a linguis Celtae et Anglosaxonum derivatus, nobilibus et comitibus designabatur. In Ecclesia primitiva, simili modo tituli dabantur viris eminentibus et potestatem habentibus. Terminus connectitur etiam cum notionibus nobilitatis, dignitatis et auctoritatis.

in_english.name: Thane
in_english.meaning: A title of nobility, a man of high rank or a noble
in_english.long_meaning: The name Thane originates from the Celtic and Anglo-Saxon languages, referring to a nobleman or a man of high rank. Historically, it was used in Scotland as a title of nobility. The name carries connotations of leadership, nobility, and high social status. In Christian tradition, similar titles are used to denote servants or followers of Christ, implying a sense of spiritual nobility and dedication.

data.cultural_impact: The name Thane carries a sense of responsibility and leadership, reflecting its historical roots as a term for a respected and influential member of a community. It is a strong and enduring name that conveys a sense of history and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Thane can be seen as a reminder of the Christian virtue of stewardship, as it speaks to the idea of being a responsible and productive member of a community. The name can also be seen as a reflection of the biblical principle of serving and leading others, as seen in the New Testament's emphasis on servanthood and leadership through humility and love. Furthermore, the name Thane can be a reminder of the spiritual significance of community and the importance of building relationships and supporting one another in our faith journey.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Thane was a title given to certain Anglo-Saxon lords and earls. The name Thane carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Thane was a rank below an earl, and above a reeve or a thegn.

trends: The name Thane is sometimes used as a given name in the English-speaking world.
In popular culture, Thane is a surname and a given name.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Thane remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Thane in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Thane, which means "Person, settler". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Thane, meaning "servant" or "kneeler" in Old English, symbolizes the humility and devotion of a Christian, constantly striving to serve God and kneel before Him in submission and love.
